name: vault
title: Nautilus Vault
description: Per-character item vault opened from a key item, with vault bags, a bank and merchant you can use anywhere, a Proc Locker whose items proc beside your weapon, mod slots that lend focus effects, and clicky buffs kept up while the item is vaulted. Needs the NMS client add-on for its window.

commands.name: vault_deposit
commands.description: Deposit the cursor item into a vault slot

commands.name: vault_withdraw
commands.description: Withdraw an item from a vault slot

commands.name: vault_bank
commands.description: Open the bank from the Nautilus Vault

commands.name: vault_merchant
commands.description: Open a merchant from the Nautilus Vault

commands.name: vault_deposit_bagitem_specific
commands.description: Deposit the cursor item into a vault bag slot

commands.name: vault_withdraw_bagitem
commands.description: Withdraw an item from a vault bag slot
